changes.schedule: The first Friday of every month, starting Fri, Dec 4, 2026. Meet 6:30 pm at the rainbow crosswalk at Central Ave and Portland St; it rolls at 7:00 pm and is back about 9:45 pm.
changes.pace: About 10 to 12 mph, flat. Nobody gets dropped.
changes.description: A queer social night ride through Phoenix's history, hosted by Robert Castan of Cycle for Change. About 24 flat miles from the 2018 rainbow crosswalk at Central and Portland: down Washington Street on the route of the first Pride march in 1981, out to Greenwood Memory Lawn, through the old west-side neighborhoods to the Melrose Curve and Charlie's, Steele Indian School Park and Coronado, and home on the old Fruit Loop bar circuit. No-drop, free.
